name: OmaLiftoff
author: OmaLiftoff contributors
description: Next rocket launch in your Omarchy bar: countdown, live flight events and a launch popup. Needs the OmaLiftoff companion (daemon + TUI, installed by the bundled install.sh); the widget itself only reads its local cache.

schema.label: Show vehicle name
schema.description: Falcon 9 · T-02:14:07 vs. T-02:14:07 (next to the rocket icon)

schema.label: Show text
schema.description: auto: icon + text in the center section, icon only in the left/right sections (and on vertical bars). The tooltip always has the full text.

schema.label: Providers (comma separated, blank = all)
schema.description: Only count down to launches by these providers, e.g. SpaceX, Rocket Lab. Matches name or abbreviation.

schema.label: Live mode window (minutes)
schema.description: Inside this window the rocket icon pulses in the accent color (the text stays plain); the popup marks the launch LIVE.

schema.label: Hide when next launch is more than N days away (0 = never)
Popup status colors
schema.description: Colors in the popup. The bar shows plain theme text; only the rocket icon is colored (accent pulse while live, red on hold/failure).

schema.label: TUI launcher
schema.description: Command used to open `liftoff tui` from the popup.
